newsitem.title: USA: Choice Hotels stake raised by Ronald Baron.
newsitem.headline: Choice Hotels stake raised by Ronald Baron.

text.p: New York investor Ronald Baron on Tuesday said he raised his stake in Choice Hotels to 15 percent. or 9,407,484 common shares.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Baron said he bought through his firms 1,108,100 additional shares of Choice Hotels between December 18 to January 6 at prices ranging from $16.1274 to $17.5717 each.
Baron is president of Baron Capital Management Inc, a New York-based investment firm.
Choice Hotels is an international lodging company based in Silver Spring, Maryland.
